hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. On each swap, it deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from configured Euler vaults, verifies a parametric curve invariant, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta to the PoolManager, bypassing the built-in CLAMM pricing entirely. Concentrated liquidity and donations are blocked to prevent non-productive positions.
